 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In October 22 James Davolos of Horizon Kinetics Preferred Shares Podcast 1h 9m Welcome to Episode 38 of the Preferred Shares Podcast. 

 In this episode, we interview James Davolos, Portfolio Manager and Director of Research of Horizon Kinetics. James gives an overview of Horizon’s contrarian value approach, and we then discuss the broad topic of inflation. We then move onto the types of businesses James feels should benefit from a higher interest rate environment such which are in the portfolio of Horizon’s Inflation Beneficiaries ETF (INFL). Resource royalties, land, water, and financial exchanges are some of the major examples. The episode ends with James sharing some poignant advice for anyone interested in investing. We hope you enjoy.
